note: Item codes are the .sav column names, unchanged by data/ecuador_2011_safety.do (Table 12, local survey_cols I75 I7601 I7602 I7603 I7604 I77 I78 I79 I710). The .sav variable labels tie all 9 codes to form questions 7.5-7.10 by content (I75. Fue victima de estafa / fraude; I7601-I7604 robo total de automotor / robo parcial de automotor / robo a vivienda / Le robaron a usted; I77 amenaza; I78 Le dispararon, cortaron, apunalaron o golpearon; I79 Fue secuestrado; I710 tentativa de asesinato), 9/9. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire, p.9, not the terse .sav labels (e.g. the I710 label names only tentativa de asesinato while form 7.10 asks about attempted murder, abuse of trust, forgery or sexual offences). Each single question ships with its printed underlined heading prefixed (ESTAFA/FRAUDE:, INTIMIDACION/AMENAZA:, HERIDAS/LESIONES:, SECUESTRO:, OTROS DELITOS:); the 7.6 heading+stem ROBO: ... victima de ... ships once as section_prompt of section _2 over I7601-I7604, whose option phrases keep the form space before each closing ?. Deviations: line-break hyphens rejoined (cual-quier, empuja-ron, resca-te), justified double spaces collapsed, interviewer lines MARQUE UN SOLO CODIGO / ANOTE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES (RM) not shipped; instructions blank (no text common to all six questions). Resp: .sav value labels 1=Si, 2=No; the do-file maps Si->1, No->0. option_text is the form casing per question: SI/NO for 7.6 (legend SI = 1 NO = 2), Si/No elsewhere. Route 9 by server-side GROUP BY (no export): live item x resp counts equal .sav counts in 18/18 cells, and the 9 count vectors are mutually distinct. English _translated columns are machine translation by this project.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns is an IRW machine translation of the Spanish INEC questionnaire; these nine items (questions 7.5-7.10) ask whether the respondent suffered each specific crime between September 2010 and August 2011, not about the circumstances or reporting of the most recent crime.
